title: Apple Notes now available in the LAS/SBS downloads
summary: Apple finally built an import feature that doesn't suck.
content:
Our pre-built systems, which come with files for you to build your JDex, have never supported Apple Notes. I tried! You've no idea how hard I tried. But previous versions of Notes just didn't have an import feature that worked. I mean it worked but your notes ended up in 8pt Times New Roman, it looked ridiculous.

Well finally Apple spent some of that $5 trillion and they built an import feature that doesn't suck! Yay. You need to be on Tahoe (26) or above – I'm stuck here on Sequoia because I refuse to have Liquid Glass in my life.

Anyway. There you go. It's in the folder of JDex downloads, let me know if you have any problems with it. There's a Discord thread here.
